title: Skeleton

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Skeletons are aggressive creatures found in the Black Forests and the Swamps guarding Burial Chambers and sometimes Ruined towers.
Skeletons appear 80% of the time as melee variants and 20% of the time as ranged variants.
Melee have a 25% chance to equip a Wood shield and a 25% chance for a Bronze buckler. Shields are purely cosmetic and don't drop on death.

sections.heading: Sword
sections.text: Does a horizontal slash that extends 1.8 meters and arcs 90 degrees (25 Slash damage). This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used within 1.6 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Bow
sections.text: Nocks an arrow and shoots the player (20 Pierce damage). The arrow travels at 30 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 2–20 degrees. This attack has a 4-second cooldown and can be used within 20 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Skeletons cannot swim or drown, and will instead walk on the seafloor.
• Starred Skeletons also appear in the "She is hot on the trail" event.

Introduction. Skeletons are aggressive creatures found in the Black Forests and the Swamps guarding Burial Chambers and sometimes Ruined towers.
Skeletons appear 80% of the time as melee variants and 20% of the time as ranged variants.
Melee have a 25% chance to equip a Wood shield and a 25% chance for a Bronze buckler. Shields are purely cosmetic and don't drop on death.

Sword. Does a horizontal slash that extends 1.8 meters and arcs 90 degrees (25 Slash damage). This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used within 1.6 meters of a player.

Bow. Nocks an arrow and shoots the player (20 Pierce damage). The arrow travels at 30 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 2–20 degrees. This attack has a 4-second cooldown and can be used within 20 meters of a player.

Notes. • Skeletons cannot swim or drown, and will instead walk on the seafloor.
• Starred Skeletons also appear in the "She is hot on the trail" event.
